info.title: gribcov.me - agent-facing resources
info.description: Read-only public resources of https://gribcov.me, the personal site of Alexandr Gribcov. No authentication, no write operations. Intended for AI agents and crawlers: the site exposes its own content, not a product API.

get.description: Returns the homepage as HTML. Send `Accept: text/markdown` to receive the same content as Markdown (content negotiation).
Structured Markdown summary of Alexandr Gribcov: roles, track record, tech stack, products and contacts. Follows https://llmstxt.org/.
Canonical URLs of the public pages, per the Sitemaps protocol.
Linkset describing the resources listed here, plus the OpenAPI description of this API.
